method: Seven alternating reference/tiled pairs per shape; each timed call copies the same source and then normalizes. Custom metrics are per-variant medians, while Go ns/op covers the complete pair and timing overhead. Setup and allocations are untimed.
limits: Host was not isolated. A prior sequential benchmark showed large background-load drift; alternating pairs reduce order bias. This measures the normalization operator plus source copy, not complete image-generation throughput or paging. No full checkpoint run was made.
workspace: Fixed 256-float (1024-byte) local tile; zero heap allocations and no retained workspace increase.
validation: Bitwise agreement with the pre-change float32 loop on ordinary, zero and subnormal inputs, including partial tiles.
Equivalent signed-zero, overflow, infinity and NaN behavior.
Existing Qwen-Image VAE and complete pipeline reference tests pass with CGO_ENABLED=0 and CGO_ENABLED=1.
